_about: Achievement names that are both a raid achievement and a group mission / conquest achievement (top-level entries in Klucifer's Mischief /outputfile achievement export, Nov 2026). A 'Your guildmate ... has completed' log line for one of these only counts as the raid when heard during a raid fight that character was in. Conqueror of the House of Thule is left out: its other entry is the meta achievement, which also means the raid was beaten.
